scientific_integrity: General algebraic and analytic proofs provided; independent finite code enumerates 9,887 matrices but does not certify all dimensions. Full original work peer review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unrestricted symmetric tridiagonal matrices over finite fields only. Known t=0 invertible counts and connected-binary-path rank counts are credited, not claimed original. Unindexed equivalent formulas are a priority risk; general proof is not independently certified.
title: Complete corank census and Gaussian nullity law for symmetric finite-field tridiagonal matrices
